title: EVA Preparation: Tether and Tool Check

steps.hint: It is the panel on your right, labelled AIRLOCK. All EVA preparation controls are grouped there.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the display ahead of you. EVA steps are always worked from the checklist.
The orange TETHER HOOK floats on your left. A tether keeps you attached to the vehicle at all times.

steps.instruction: Place the hook on the TETHER ANCHOR.
steps.hint: TETHER ANCHOR is the left bay on the TOOL RACK panel. Only the tether hook fits that anchor.
TETHER CHECK is the top-left button on the AIRLOCK panel. It confirms the hook is locked before you continue.
Turn the SUIT PRESSURE dial on the AIRLOCK panel to NOMINAL. Nominal means the expected operating value.
The PISTOL GRIP tool floats above the tether hook on your left. Never release a tool without securing it.

steps.instruction: Place the tool in the TOOL CADDY.
steps.hint: TOOL CADDY is the right bay on the TOOL RACK panel. A secured tool cannot drift away.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm EVA preparation.
steps.hint: REPORT is below TETHER CHECK on the AIRLOCK panel. Do not use DEPRESS VALVE; depressurising is a later step.
